recommendations.title: Refresh: Add interactive payback calculator and example outputs
recommendations.details: Integrate an interactive calculator page or visible widget into the existing 'Hur räknar man ut återbetalningstiden för solceller' guide that lets users input PV size (kWp), current annual production or exported kWh, current self‑consumption share, electricity price or area (SE1–SE4), battery size (kWh) and inverter power (kW). The tool should compute net cost after green deduction, annual value from increased self‑consumption, arbitrage, and potential ancillary‑service revenue under low/median/high scenarios, and output payback years plus sensitivity ranges. Include an option to export assumptions and a short explanation of each revenue stream.

recommendations.title: Create: Step‑by‑step worked examples for common PV+battery pairings
recommendations.details: Produce a short guide with 3–4 fully worked examples (5 kWp+5 kWh, 7 kWp+10 kWh, 7 kWp+15 kWh, etc.) that show line‑by‑line calculations: net installed cost after green deduction, kWh shifted to self‑consumption, value per kWh, expected annual revenue from arbitrage and services, warranty considerations, and final payback. Use Stockholm (SE3) and Malmö (SE4) variants to illustrate area effects.
